newsitem.title: GERMANY: German wholesale prices on uptrend.
newsitem.headline: German wholesale prices on uptrend.

text.p: Germany's Federal Statistics Office on Monday said wholesale prices rose by 0.8 percent in March, while the year-on-year increase accelerated to 1.6 percent.
Wholesale prices had risen by a monthly 0.3 percent in February and 1.4 percent over a year earlier.
The annual wholesale price rise was the highest in a run of six consecutive monthly increases, which followed a year-long run of price falls, historical data show.

Biggest gains in individual items in March came in coffee, which rose 18 percent, fresh vegetables (+6.5 percent), non-precious metals and scrap (+5.3 percent) and livestock for slaughter (+4.9 percent).
Cheaper in the latest month were sea fish (-11 percent), heating oil (-7.1 percent) and diesel fuel (-3.4 percent).
